_comment: Frozen reason classes and eligibility (docs/DESIGN_V2.md D16, D22): every finding code with its one class (auth, enrichment, content, sender, link, claim), whether the kind may count as a reason, and the content-free reason why. The tests fail if app/reason_classes.py and this file differ, so a changed entry is a deliberate edit of both in one commit.

AUTH_ALIGN_NONE_ALIGNED.reason: computed only when a trusted receiver evaluated both SPF and DKIM; neither authenticated the From domain

AUTH_CLAIM_DECOY_LINKS.reason: a real structural signal: the claimed entity's own domain is linked but did not send it

AUTH_CLAIM_ENTITY_MISMATCH_UNSIGNED.reason: a real structural signal: links belong to another entity and the message is unsigned

AUTH_DKIM_CHECK_FAILED.reason: a trusted receiver's failed result about this message

AUTH_DKIM_FAILURE_CLAIMED_UNTRUSTED.reason: untrusted claim: the result was written below the trust boundary, so it is shown but never counted

AUTH_DKIM_NOT_EVALUATED.reason: gap: info severity, the method was not evaluated by a trusted receiver

AUTH_DMARC_CHECK_FAILED.reason: a trusted receiver's failed result about this message

AUTH_DMARC_FAILURE_CLAIMED_UNTRUSTED.reason: untrusted claim: the result was written below the trust boundary, so it is shown but never counted

AUTH_DMARC_NOT_EVALUATED.reason: gap: info severity, the method was not evaluated by a trusted receiver

AUTH_FROM_HEADER_AMBIGUOUS.reason: parse note: informational, weight 0, it describes how the header was written and not what the message does

AUTH_IDENTITY_DISPLAY_NAME_FUZZY.reason: a real signal (fuzzy display-name match); deliberately untagged, so it cannot feed the structural floor

AUTH_IDENTITY_DISPLAY_NAME_SPOOF.reason: a real signal: the display name claims a brand the sending domain does not own

AUTH_IDENTITY_FREE_MAILBOX_BRAND.reason: a real structural signal about who sent the message

AUTH_IDENTITY_LOCAL_SUBMISSION.reason: a real structural signal about how the message entered the path

AUTH_IDENTITY_MACHINE_SENDER_BRAND.reason: a real structural signal about who sent the message

AUTH_IDENTITY_REPLY_TO_MISMATCH.reason: a real signal in the message's own headers (replies are redirected)

AUTH_IDENTITY_RETURN_PATH_MISMATCH.reason: a weak but real signal in the message's own headers; common with mail services

AUTH_SPF_CHECK_FAILED.reason: a trusted receiver's failed result about this message

AUTH_SPF_FAILURE_CLAIMED_UNTRUSTED.reason: untrusted claim: the result was written below the trust boundary, so it is shown but never counted

AUTH_SPF_NOT_EVALUATED.reason: gap: info severity, the method was not evaluated by a trusted receiver

CONTENT_BRAND_LINK_MISMATCH.reason: a real signal: a brand named in the body is linked to a different domain

CONTENT_GREETING_PERSONAL_CLAIM.reason: a real signal in the message text

CONTENT_LANGUAGE_NO_TEXT.reason: gap: info severity, there was no readable text

CONTENT_LANGUAGE_UNDETERMINED.reason: gap: info severity, the language could not be confirmed

CONTENT_LANGUAGE_UNSUPPORTED.reason: gap: info severity, content heuristics were not applied to this language

CONTENT_LINK_HOTLINKED_ASSETS.reason: a real structural signal about the message's images and links

CONTENT_LINK_REDIRECTOR.reason: a real structural signal about the message's links

CONTENT_LINK_TRACKER_PLATFORM_MISMATCH.reason: a real structural signal about the message's links

CONTENT_URGENCY_LANGUAGE.reason: a real signal in the message text

ENRICH_INCOMPLETE_INTERNAL_HOST.reason: gap: info severity, never sent to an external service

ENRICH_INCOMPLETE_PROVIDER_NO_RESULT.reason: gap: info severity, a provider gave no usable answer

ENRICH_INCOMPLETE_SHARED_PLATFORM.reason: gap: info severity, a shared platform with no reputation lookup

ENRICH_PROVIDERS_NO_USABLE_ANSWER.reason: gap: info severity, a summary of providers without an answer

ENRICH_REPUTATION_HASH_KNOWN_MALICIOUS.reason: a real signal: a lookup scored the attachment hash above zero

ENRICH_REPUTATION_HOST_SUSPICIOUS.reason: a real signal: a lookup scored the host above zero

ENRICH_SKIPPED_PER_EMAIL_LIMIT.reason: gap: the indicator was not looked up because of a limit, so nothing is known about it
